_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

emergency_tanzania_112.name: Emergency services
emergency_tanzania_112.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Tanzania Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police)" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority, National Numbering Plan v13 (June 2020): "Table 16: Life and safety (free of charge) services ... 112 Emergency, Police Operational" (https://web.archive.org/web/2021id_/https://www.tcra.go.tz/uploads/text-editor/files/National%20Numbering%20Plan%20%28Updated%20June%2C%202020%29_1622553220.pdf) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): TZ 112 types ['AMBULANCE', 'FIRE', 'POLICE']. Sources agree it reaches: police. Listed beyond that by some sources only: ambulance, fire. MEDIUM confidence — owner-directed second-opinion review 2026-10-29 (not human verification); FCDO said 112 (ambulance, fire, police), Wikipedia said 112 under police, ambulance 114, fire 115, police also 999. Second-opinion review cites: TCRA National Numbering Plan (2026); no URL supplied — check at source. Public ambulance coverage outside the cities is limited. This number's provenance: FCDO. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/tanzania/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Tanzania Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police)" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia partially differs: lists 112 under police, ambulance 114, fire 115, police also 999. 'languages' = the locale this entry is staged for (sw), not a verified statement of operator languages.
